messages.notion.connection.auth-help: Use a Notion internal integration token. Share each page you want to read with the integration.
messages.notion.connection.inbound: Feed retrieves page and database updates
messages.notion.guide.cli-note: Sign in to the Notion CLI through a browser to call the API. Molis Work does not read its local authorization.
messages.notion.guide.mcp-connected-note: Authorize this separately. It does not inherit the pages selected in the current Notion API OAuth grant.
messages.notion.guide.mcp-note: Authorize this separately. It does not inherit the pages selected in the current Notion API OAuth grant. Molis Work has not integrated it.
messages.notion.guide.oauth-note: The app supports Notion API OAuth. Create a public connection and set up the local callback.
messages.notion.guide.token-note: Use an official PAT or Internal Integration Token. The readable content depends on user permissions or the pages shared with the integration.
